entities.summary: Joseph Albert Reyes is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, Toronto Blue Jays, Baltimore Orioles, and Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim. He also played in the KBO League for the SK Wyverns.
